QWindowKit 1.5.1
Source: https://github.com/stdware/qwindowkit
Commit: 5626b3ae5f22508d77361495f589abedb39c2ee4
Commit date: 2026-10-12

Build environment:
- Qt 6.8.3, MSVC 2022 x64 kit
- MSVC 19.50.35728.0, x64
- Shared libraries
- Core, Widgets, and Quick modules
- Debug and Release configurations
- Debug linker PDB files included in debug/qwindowkit/bin

Install prefixes:
- debug/qwindowkit
- release/qwindowkit

Git-managed release artifacts:
- artifacts/qwindowkit-1.5.1-qt6.8.3-msvc-x64-debug.zip
- artifacts/qwindowkit-1.5.1-qt6.8.3-msvc-x64-release.zip

The installed prefixes are generated locally by scripts/Prepare-QWindowKit.ps1.
Artifact checksums are stored in qwindowkit-manifest.json.
